speaker: Daniel
text: Traveling solo has been sometimes a blessing, sometimes a curse. I remember searching desperately for accommodations in China. The university listed in my booklet no longer had dormitories for travelers, and I was lucky when the desk clerk called a young woman out of a nearby office. As it turned out, she was offering to let me stay at her flat and even had a friend come and show me around the next day. It was a blessing overall!
